For
An Act to establish the South-West Development Commission charged with the responsibility of
among other things, receiving and managing funds from allocation of the Federation Account,
including donations and gifts for the reconstruction and rehabilitation of infrastructural damages
suffered in the region and to tackle the ecological, environmental and other developmental
chanenges in the region, and for retated matters.
